module: Small "Metallic paint" imgui debug window to adjust the metallic paint parameters of the player's vehicle live (3 paints: metallic, roughness, clearcoat, clearcoat roughness). It reads and writes the object field `metallicPaintData` of the vehicle as a string of 4 numbers.
notes: The 4 values of metallicPaintData are, in order: [1] Roughness, [2] Metallic, [3] Coat, [4] Coat roughness (from the indices passed to sliderUI). Each slider goes from 0 to 1.
changeData always writes only to paint 0: its index parameter designates the array component, not the paint.

show.desc: Opens the 'Metallic paint' window (the window is drawn in onUpdate).

changeData.desc: Modifies one component of metallicPaintData of player 0's vehicle paint 0 and rewrites the field.

index.desc: Index (1 to 4) in the array of 4 values.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: if the window is open and a player vehicle exists, draws the sliders of paints 0, 1 and 2 and applies the changes via setField.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: creates the visibility boolean pointer (false) and the float pointer of the sliders.
